title: Automatic Transmissions
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the automatic transmission rebuilding industry.
Demonstrate their ability to assess, evaluate and solve problems common to automatic transmission repair in the automotive, industrial, and agricultural industries.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the core material of automatic transmission rebuilding required for transfer to a four year university or certification in the department programs.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (AUTOB11, AUTOB30, AUTOB46); AUTOB11 and AUTOB30 are matched to closed-list AUTO B11 and AUTO B30.

AUTOB46 Automatic Transmissions (5 units) is not on the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition.
